moworks.notes: Target moves 0 → 1 on an over-damped spring, stiffness 120, damping 26, mass 1 (damping ratio 1.19): no overshoot, within 1 % by ~830 ms. Kit form: springk(120, 26) over 0.83 s. Rule: elegant arrivals, near body text. Small demo: the target moves 102 px beside the response graph, with overshoot and settle readouts. Params: stiffness (120) · damping (26) · mass (1) · duration (0.83 s). Over-damped (ratio 1.19): no overshoot, in by ~0.83 s, like a damped door; fine near body text.
